spec.scene: A patch of blue gym matting holds a tall grey overhanging climbing wall at the back, studded with colorful holds and chalky handprints. The purple-hold route climbs the overhang at the center, with a small climber in a yellow tank top at its top, one arm punched up. Below right, a friend in a teal shirt stands with arms raised. A round white chalk bag rests front-left, dusted with powder. At the back edge, a fragment of warm orange wall shows a small painted elephant. Dusk light glows warm through a tall window slice behind.
spec.title: Sending the Purple V4
spec.caption: First try on the purple V4 — I actually screamed. Sam laughed so hard. Call Mom about Thanksgiving. Maybe tomorrow.
